posts.name: MOHAN
posts.cooked:
thank you for the help , but i already solve the problem with this

Task Command / Key
Open in vim vim script.sh
Insert mode Press i
Save & Exit Press Esc, then type :wq, Enter
Execute (Git Bash) & "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe" ./script.sh
Execute (WSL) wsl ./script.sh
